motion: a soft light glints along the polished edge
wood chips jump out of the drilled hole
tiny bubbles rise slowly from the metal
dense bubbles rise and the dark foam shifts slowly
fine bubbles rise steadily from the hatchet head
the file moves forward and filings fall to the bench
the rasp strokes along the wood and shavings fall
the head moves down with each tap and settles tight
the hammer hits and the wedge sinks a few millimetres each time
the rag strokes along the handle and the wood turns golden
the blade moves in circles on the stone and grey slurry builds up
the thread pulls tight with each stitch
the hatchet comes down and the log splits open sending chips flying
a soft glint moves along the steel
